create_file_before_job: create a file or directory on the filesystem before a benchpress job runs using FileHook before_job
delete_file_after_job: delete a file or directory on the filesystem after a benchpress job completes using FileHook after_job
create_dir_before_job: create a directory using os.makedirs before a benchpress job runs via FileHook before_job
delete_dir_after_job: recursively remove a directory using shutil.rmtree after a benchpress job via FileHook after_job
review_filehook_class: review the FileHook class and its before_job and after_job methods for file and directory lifecycle management
